threads.label: Your treasure map.
threads.text: It brought you to Brandonsford at sunset, but you don't recognize its marked places. Where they are, and which one holds the treasure, is still unknown.

threads.label: The black dragon.
threads.text: Eric the Reeve offers a thousand gold for its body, dragged into town. Sir Phidipaldi then challenged him to a duel. Lady Hilda will hunt it with you if paid.

threads.label: The Clurichen.
threads.text: Reginald the frog warned Dr. Uriah that this trickster comes into town from the riverbanks every night.

threads.label: Bentley's shipment.
threads.text: It is overdue, and nothing has arrived in months. What happened to it is still unknown.

threads.label: Drop Dead Ned.
threads.text: This thief with a killer wasp offered to work for Dr. Uriah for a hundred gold a week, and he is thinking it over. Ned insists on killing people with the wasp.

threads.label: Quinn's vanishing ale.
threads.text: Someone empties his good ale at the Golden Egg each night, and nobody knows who or what. Sir Phidipaldi agreed to help catch them for a hundred gold.

threads.label: Dunk's night with Farmer Gill.
threads.text: They spent it drinking, and Gill told him the legend of Sir Brandon's dragon.

closing: Sir Phidipaldi and Quinn are in the empty Golden Egg, about to fill Quinn's bottles with water so Sir Phidipaldi can make a big show of delivering them. Wayman and Dr. Uriah are across the street at the Clumsy Fox. Dunk is staying the night in Farmer Gill's barn.
